out_of_scope.adv3_d44f1a8a0469acb7: The advisory describes a stack overflow in the SignalR/Blazor MessagePack hub protocol caused by deeply nested arrays. The v8.0.28 fix dc6799d732 ("Merged PR 61221: Update MessagePack", 2026-05-19) does not change any deserializer logic in this repository: it bumps eng/Versions.props MessagePackVersion from 2.5.187 to 2.5.301, applies src/submodules/msgpack-fix-full.diff and upstream-patch.diff to the MessagePack-CSharp submodule, and adds only a regression test in src/SignalR/common/SignalR.Common/test/Internal/Protocol/MessagePackHubProtocolTestBase.cs. The deserializer that recurses on nested arrays lives in the separate project aspnet/MessagePack-CSharp (a .gitmodules entry at the frozen SHA; the submodule has no content in the frozen tree), so the root cause is outside this repository and cannot be anchored here.
out_of_scope.adv3_683c84ac5fc83514: NVD describes CVE-2026-92707 as a MessagePack for C# defect: PrimitiveObjectFormatter allocates an object[] from each declared array length before the object-graph depth limit rejects the input, fixed in MessagePack 2.5.303 and 3.1.9; an ASP.NET Core SignalR hub with an object parameter is only named as one exposure path. The v8.0.32 fix in this repository is 21f2be26fd ("Update MessagePack to 2.5.303 (#69370)", 2026-09-21), i.e. a dependency version bump, and eng/Versions.props at v8.0.32 reads <MessagePackVersion>2.5.303</MessagePackVersion>. No file in this repository contains the formatter or its depth handling; the defect belongs to MessagePack-CSharp, so this repository cannot carry a source anchor for it.

notes: CVE-2026-42899 is promoted at FormDataReader.ProcessFormKeys (124-165): the -1 sentinel is checked after startIndex is added, so an unmatched "[" at a non-zero index leaves startIndex unchanged and the while loop never exits. The v8.0.27 fix ab7d766648 (public backport #66674) deletes the function.

CVE-2026-45591 and CVE-2026-92707 are out of scope for this repository: both fixes are MessagePack dependency updates (2.5.187 -> 2.5.301 in 8.0.28; 2.5.303 in 8.0.32) and the vulnerable deserializer lives in the external aspnet/MessagePack-CSharp submodule, not in aspnetcore files.
